name: upright piano
caption: An upright piano with a tall cabinet, a full keyboard and two end panels. A full width keyboard sits on a shelf; the cabinet carries a straight lid. Flat cabinet panels keep a constant thickness with a stepped keyboard shelf. Overall width is 2.40 times depth; height is 0.95 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, near black, ivory white color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
